description: Cross-SDK conformance vectors for POST /auth/offline/activate. Mock the server with each case's response, call activate_offline(licenseKey, path) with the config below, and check expect. Every case must also assert the request (method, path, body fields).

config.note: Use the SDK's HWID override (or test hook) to make the local HWID equal config.hwid.

request.note: Body must carry exactly these fields: appId, appSecret and licenseKey from config, hwid equal to the HWID login() would send, and a fresh nonce from the SDK's existing generator.

expectations.activated: Return success, write fileWritten byte-for-byte to path (atomically, creating parent directories), and leave the client authenticated with session kind 'offline' and the listed variables, exactly as login_from_file() would. No heartbeat starts.
expectations.error: Surface errorCode through the SDK's error type, with fatal/transient as listed. Do not write path, do not modify an existing file at path, do not exit the process, and leave the client unauthenticated.
expectations.offline_file_rejected: SDK-level code for a success response whose file fails local verification. `detail` is the verifier's reason; include it in the error message.

cases.name: activated_new_machine
cases.description: 201: a new file for this machine. Verify, write it, start an offline session.

cases.name: reject_missing_file
cases.description: Success status without a file field. Existing malformed-response handling; do not write.

cases.name: error_offline_activation_disabled
cases.description: The app has not opted in to self-serve activation.

cases.name: error_offline_activation_requires_perpetual
cases.description: The license has an expiry; only perpetual licenses can self-serve.

cases.name: error_offline_activation_limit_reached
cases.description: Every machine slot on the license is used. HWID resets do not free them; the buyer must contact the vendor.

cases.name: error_hwid_mismatch
cases.description: No free seat for this machine.

cases.name: error_invalid_key
cases.description: Existing code, existing classification (transient in every SDK today).

cases.name: error_no_credits
cases.description: The app owner is out of credits. Existing code, existing classification.

cases.name: error_rate_limited
cases.description: Existing code. The SDK may retry exactly as login() does for rate_limited; a server that keeps answering this ends in this error.
